comments.author: Ming Mei
comments.body: You shouldn't be using this or the LMS for trade, 99% of the time I never carry cargo besides food/water/timber (shipwrecks). My LMS tops in at 13-14 knots with 110/110 +7T +7WR in 'normal waters' and have clocked as much as 17 knots in the pacific with the bonuses. The top speed isn't as high as some clippers, you really make up for it with the 11-13+ knots you can do in headwinds depending on the zone bonus. I've loaded my LMS down with Saori from time to time to fund my shipwrecks, it's about a 60 day trip from Sakai to Seville across the Pacific fully loaded (at min effective cargo carrying 1250 Saori using survival-no food/water). If you want to adventure grind to 65 trade, grab the LMS set it up for speed cheap. Once you hit 65 adventure you'll be ready for this beast, use your Storm Sails you've collected from all your shipwrecks get the WR up to 25+ and watch flames shoot off the water when you sail.

comments.author: Chester
comments.body: If you can afford it, the CLS is a cheap version of the MLS and costs about 3b for a ticket. It's pretty much decent, you can max the WR and turn and once 2nd age hits with the ability to do ship upgrades (not improves, you get to put additional abilities on the ship based on its rank upgrade) you can opt for acceleration upgrades, that will nullify the current advantage of the MLS having more improves for armor accel. at 1/4 the price of an MLS (I still can't understand why ANYONE would pay more than 10b for a ship that is only marginally faster than an FLC/CLC and the same speed as the Non-NC version assuming you sail at top speed with no cargo)
